Summary
Alex writes to Jack about the uncertainty of their departure due to a fire at the depot. They mention changing their yen into U.S. dollars, shopping in Tokyo, and the cost of cigarettes and other items. Alex expresses hope for a successful future and bids farewell until their next meeting.

--- Page 1 (Beckerman_58a) --- Dear Jack, Received your letter a little while back and sure was glad to hear from you again. I am taking a chord in writing to you since you may be on the way by the time this reaches you. I hope you aren't there to receive this but then again you might since I know how the snafu the situation is with officers getting released and starting home. We were all set to leave here yesterday at 2 o'clock for the depot, but just our lousy luck they had a fire and part of it burnt down so now the rumor is we will be taking OB from here on Friday the 21st. So don't answer this because I won't get any more mail when I leave here it all will be sent to our home address. We changed all our yen into U.S. money at Finance today. I had 160 half in cash and have a Finance check. I sent home a [illegible] and the other I think [illegible] I have a [illegible] rank cloth [illegible] this. I [illegible] sent [illegible] and we are just spending our time laying around and sightseeing. I made a couple of trips to Tokyo and went shopping on the famous [illegible] blockmarket here is really big and [illegible] stuff yet. [illegible] for all who want to take the risk. Cigarettes --- Page 2 (Beckerman_58b) --- we 25 yen a pack one 1.60 2/3, a little old [illegible] small transpoid [illegible] Hershey bar is 10 yen or 4.66 2/3. So you can get an idea of what I mean. all these [illegible] have loads of love but nothing to buy. I picked up a couple three nine watches over here also and will take them along with me. On the whole things are going along alright well and I hope they turn out all right with you. So I will see you again on home ground the next time, so until then I will say adios and good bye [illegible] brother Alex
